title: Benzyl methyl morpholinium hydroxide (BMMorph)OH: a new basic ionic liquid for N-alkylation of bioactive N-heterocycles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7923-7935
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10042A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohammad Navid Soltani Rad, Somayeh Behrouz, Hamid Reza Mohammadnia Afroozi
We report benzyl methyl morpholinium hydroxide ([BMMorph]OH) as a novel, stable basic ionic liquid that exhibits dual functionality as both an efficient reaction medium and a strong base for the N-alkylation of bioactive N-heterocycles.
